source.title: 请选择Queen B下班风格
source.creator: 不爱吃榴莲的Nana
source.method: Anonymous official view/player/playurl endpoints and ffmpeg key-frame extraction; original video checked by visual observation. No login cookies exported.
source.downloadQuality: Official anonymous360p (480×360); higher-quality request downgraded to16. Original upload metadata3840×2880 is not the analyzed download resolution.
notes: The page auto-played an unrelated recommended video; that video was excluded and the requested BV was reopened before observations.
Source explicitly labels three main styles: Mob wife风,拿破仑风,Napoleon core,and千金风. Princess at27s is character dialogue, not a fourth outfit style.
Visual observations do not establish garment composition, authenticity, exact product reference or purchase price.
The video’s Vogue/FW2026 trend assertion was not independently verified and is not adopted as a site trend claim.
The published Napoleon still is19s, avoiding the original video’s unverified media-trend claim shown around21s.
